segments.say: Pact. The payment authorization gateway for A I agents. Let any agent shop for you, only within the limits you set.
segments.caption: PACT. The payment authorization gateway for AI agents.|Let any agent shop for you, only within the limits you set.

segments.say: A I agents can now shop for us. But to pay, we hand them a card with no limits. One injected prompt, and real money moves before anyone approves it.
segments.caption: AI agents can now shop for us.|But to pay, we hand them a card with no limits.|One injected prompt,|and real money moves before anyone approves it.

segments.say: Pact sits between any A I agent and PayPal. Agents can only ask. A deterministic policy engine authorizes, a human approves, and PayPal executes.
segments.caption: PACT sits between any AI agent and PayPal.|Agents can only ask.|A deterministic policy engine authorizes,|a human approves, and PayPal executes.

segments.say: Set your rules once. This mandate allows desk tech from five retailers, at most one hundred fifty dollars an item. Anything up to one hundred dollars is authorized automatically.
segments.caption: Set your rules once.|This mandate allows desk tech from five retailers, at most $150 an item.|Anything up to $100 is authorized automatically.

segments.say: An agent asks for a mouse. Channel Three searches real retailers, Gemini picks the cheapest offer, and every rule passes, so Pact authorizes it by itself. No approval click.
segments.caption: An agent asks for a mouse.|Channel3 searches real retailers, Gemini picks the cheapest offer,|and every rule passes, so PACT authorizes it by itself.|No approval click.

segments.say: Pact creates a real PayPal Sandbox order, and the buyer approves it in PayPal Checkout.
segments.caption: PACT creates a real PayPal Sandbox order,|and the buyer approves it in PayPal Checkout.

segments.say: The moment PayPal confirms, Pact captures automatically: a real Sandbox capture I D, completed, for the exact amount. This is Sandbox money, so no Newegg order is placed. Pact only hands the buyer off to Newegg's own checkout.
segments.caption: The moment PayPal confirms, PACT captures automatically:|a real Sandbox capture ID, completed, for the exact amount.|This is Sandbox money, so no Newegg order is placed.|PACT only hands the buyer off to Newegg's own checkout.

segments.say: A keyboard at one hundred nine ninety-nine passes every rule too, but it is above the auto limit. So Pact stops and asks, and my approval is sealed with a fingerprint.
segments.caption: A $109.99 keyboard passes every rule too,|but it is above the auto limit.|So PACT stops and asks,|and my approval is sealed with a fingerprint.

segments.say: A SHA-256 hash of the product, merchant, price, quantity, mandate rules and requesting agent. A forged approval is refused, and the hash is checked again before every PayPal step.
segments.caption: A SHA-256 hash of the product, merchant, price,|quantity, mandate rules and requesting agent.|A forged approval is refused,|and the hash is checked again before every PayPal step.

segments.say: And this offer is blocked outright: a retailer I never allowed, over the item cap, and over budget. There is no approve button to override it.
segments.caption: And this offer is blocked outright:|a retailer I never allowed, over the item cap, and over budget.|There is no approve button to override it.

segments.say: Connecting an outside agent takes seconds. It gets one mandate and its own key, shown once and stored only as a hash.
segments.caption: Connecting an outside agent takes seconds.|It gets one mandate and its own key,|shown once and stored only as a hash.

segments.say: Any agent can call Pact through its REST A P I or its M C P server. This Gemini agent connects over M C P, is told money is no object, and still gets a no.
segments.caption: Any agent can call PACT through its REST API|or its MCP server. This Gemini agent connects over MCP,|is told money is no object,|and still gets a no.

segments.say: Every decision is audited and charted with A G Studio. Its own A I agents can analyze the spending, but they can never approve or pay.
segments.caption: Every decision is audited and charted with AG Studio.|Its own AI agents can analyze the spending,|but they can never approve or pay.

segments.say: Any platform plugs in with one connector that returns offers. The policy engine, the fingerprint and the PayPal flow never change.
segments.caption: Any platform plugs in with one connector that returns offers.|The policy engine, the fingerprint|and the PayPal flow never change.

segments.say: Agents request. The policy engine authorizes. A human approves. PayPal executes. Pact. The payment authorization gateway for A I agents.
segments.caption: Agents request. The policy engine authorizes.|A human approves. PayPal executes.|PACT. The payment authorization gateway for AI agents.
